name: Kamifurano (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Kamifurano town emblem in red and white: a red cogwheel-like disc bearing a white stylised character and outer ring.
history: Municipal flag of Kamifurano, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 5 October 1957.

features.role: Kamifurano town emblem — a red cogwheel-like disc bearing a white stylised character and outer ring
